quotes.quote: I believe that everything happens for a reason. People change so that you can learn to let go, things go wrong so that you appreciate them when they're right, you believe lies so you eventually learn to trust no one but yourself, and sometimes good things fall apart so better things can fall together.
quotes.author: Marilyn Monroe

quotes.quote: Gratitude unlocks the fullness of life. It turns what we have into enough, and more. It turns denial into acceptance, chaos to order, confusion to clarity. It can turn a meal into a feast, a house into a home, a stranger into a friend.
quotes.author: Melody Beattie

quotes.quote: Live, travel, adventure, bless, and don't be sorry.
quotes.author: Jack Kerouac

quotes.quote: Today we bury his remains in the earth as a seed of immortality. Our hearts are full of sadness, yet at the same time of joyful hope and profound gratitude.
quotes.author: Pope Benedict XVI

quotes.quote: Let us be grateful to the people who make us happy; they are the charming gardeners who make our souls blossom.
quotes.author: Marcel Proust

quotes.quote: One of the surest evidences of friendship that one individual can display to another is telling him gently of a fault. If any other can excel it, it is listening to such a disclosure with gratitude, and amending the error.
quotes.author: Edward G. Bulwer-Lytton

quotes.quote: Walk as if you are kissing the Earth with your feet.
quotes.author: Hanh Nhat Thich,  Peace Is Every Step: The Path of Mindfulness in Everyday Life

quotes.quote: You gave me a forever within the numbered days, and I'm grateful.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: We take for granted the very things that most deserve our gratitude.
quotes.author: Cynthia Ozick

quotes.quote: No book can be appreciated until it has been slept with and dreamed over.
quotes.author: Eugene Field

quotes.quote: It is thanks to my evening reading alone that I am still more or less sane.
quotes.author: W.G. Sebald,  Vertigo

quotes.quote: Maybe some people just aren't meant to be in our lives forever. Maybe some people are just passing through. It's like some people just come through our lives to bring us something: a gift, a blessing, a lesson we need to learn. And that's why they're here. You'll have that gift forever.
quotes.author: Danielle Steel,  The Gift

quotes.quote: We hope that, when the insects take over the world, they will remember with gratitude how we took them along on all our picnics.
quotes.author: Bill Vaughan

quotes.quote: You're beautiful and sad,"I said finally, not looking at him when I did. "Just like your eyes. You're like a song that I heard when I was a little kid but forgot I knew until I heard it again."For a long moment there was only the whirring sound of the tires on the road, and then Sam said softly, "Thank you.
quotes.author: Maggie Stiefvater,  Shiver

quotes.quote: Heaven knows we need never be ashamed of our tears, for they are rain upon the blinding dust of earth, overlying our hard hearts. I was better after I had cried, than before--more sorry, more aware of my own ingratitude, more gentle.
quotes.author: Charles Dickens,  Great Expectations

quotes.quote: Blessed are the hearts that can bend; they shall never be broken.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: I'm happy to say that at 62, I think I've reached that point where stuff doesn't bother me as much, and my gratitude level has gone way up, especially having gone through the loss that I've had, and losing so many of the great artists that I was close to. They taught me how to see it with a grain of salt and a lot of humor and perspective.
quotes.author: Bonnie Raitt

quotes.quote: Sometimes life knocks you on your ass... get up, get up, get up!!! Happiness is not the absence of problems, it's the ability to deal with them.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: We learned about gratitude and humility - that so many people had a hand in our success, from the teachers who inspired us to the janitors who kept our school clean... and we were taught to value everyone's contribution and treat everyone with respect.
quotes.author: Michelle Obama

quotes.quote: True happiness is to enjoy the present, without anxious dependence upon the future, not to amuse ourselves with either hopes or fears but to rest satisfied with what we have, which is sufficient, for he that is so wants nothing. The greatest blessings of mankind are within us and within our reach. A wise man is content with his lot, whatever it may be, without wishing for what he has not.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: November 11, 1802, I arrived at Judge Patterson's at Lisle. This respectable family treated me with every mark of distinction and friendship, and likewise all the people did the same. I really want for words to express my gratitude.
quotes.author: Deborah Sampson

quotes.quote: On the recollection of so many and great favours and blessings, I now, with a high sense of gratitude, presume to offer up my sincere thanks to the Almighty, the Creator and Preserver.
quotes.author: William Bartram

quotes.quote: At the end of the day, let there be no excuses, no explanations, no regrets.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Make a pact with yourself today to not be defined by your past. Sometimes the greatest thing to come out of all your hard work isn't what you get for it, but what you become for it. Shake things up today! Be You...Be Free...Share.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: If having a soul means being able to feel love and loyalty and gratitude, then animals are better off than a lot of humans.
quotes.author: James Herriot

quotes.quote: Forget yesterday - it has already forgotten you. Don't sweat tomorrow - you haven't even met. Instead, open your eyes and your heart to a truly precious gift - today.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: When we give cheerfully and accept gratefully, everyone is blessed.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.quote: Some people grumble that roses have thorns; I am grateful that thorns have roses.
quotes.author: Alphonse Karr,  A Tour Round My Garden

quotes.quote: It doesn't matter what you did or where you were...it matters where you are and what you're doing. Get out there! Sing the song in your heart and NEVER let anyone shut you up!!
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: The essence of all beautiful art, all great art, is gratitude.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: When you arise in the morning, think of what a precious privilege it is to be alive--to breathe, to think, to enjoy, to love--then make that day count!
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: More people are leaving TV behind to read my books than ever before. In the last year alone I gained over two readers (three, to be exact). So I'd like to take a moment and say thanks mom, dad, and kidnap victim I keep chained in the basement.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  The Days of Yay are Here! Wake Me Up When They're Over.

quotes.quote: Dance. Smile. Giggle. Marvel. TRUST. HOPE. LOVE. WISH. BELIEVE. Most of all, enjoy every moment of the journey, and appreciate where you are at this moment instead of always focusing on how far you have to go.
quotes.author: Mandy Hale,  The Single Woman: Life, Love, and a Dash of Sass

quotes.quote: My expectations were reduced to zero when I was 21. Everything since then has been a bonus."[The Science of Second-Guessing (New York Times Magazine Interview, December 12, 2004)]
quotes.author: Stephen Hawking

quotes.quote: I used to think how lucky she was to have me, but now I realize that's backwards. A spirit of gratitude yields patience, love, and forgiveness.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: No one who achieves success does so without acknowledging the help of others. The wise and confident acknowledge this help with gratitude.
quotes.author: Alfred North Whitehead

quotes.quote: Just an observation: it is impossible to be both grateful and depressed. Those with a grateful mindset tend to see the message in the mess. And even though life may knock them down, the grateful find reasons, if even small ones, to get up.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Free yourself from the complexities and drama of your life. Simplify. Look within. Within ourselves we all have the gifts and talents we need to fulfill the purpose we've been blessed with.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Be happy with who you are and what you do, and you can do anything you want.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: It's better if you don't come at all, then come and act like you don't want to be here. The same applies to there, when I'm there, which is also confusingly here, though it's not here it's there.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Life is about having an attitude of gratitude. And grabitude. Seriously, you've got to take stuff. What, do you think someone's just going to hand you what you want?
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: With any new business deal, don't think about how much you can afford to get--think about how much you can afford to give. A spirit of giving will allow you to get.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: The fragrance of romance is gratitude. Nothing says I love you like saying I love you. Sure, it's better to show your love, but why not also say it?
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: She plants love, and she grows roses. The fragrance of romance comes from the blossom that blooms in the heart.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: When it comes to life the critical thing is whether you take things for granted or take them with gratitude.
quotes.author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

quotes.quote: The roses of romance grow when you water your relationship with gratitude. Love will bloom and blossom when you recognize the awesome.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Let me just pause a minute and drink in this moment. And if you film it, I'll be able to get free refills for life.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: I gave her a hundred dollar bill. She said, 'Thanks, how can I repay you?' I replied, 'Two fifties would be good, but three fifties would be better.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Although time seems to fly, it never travels faster than one day at a time. Each day is a new opportunity to live your life to the fullest. In each waking day, you will find scores of blessings and opportunities for positive change. Do not let your TODAY be stolen by the unchangeable past or the indefinite future! Today is a new day!
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Those who have the ability to be grateful are the ones who have the ability to achieve greatness.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Got no checkbooks, got no banks. Still I'd like to express my thanks - I've got the sun in the mornin' and the moon at night.
quotes.author: Irving Berlin

quotes.quote: The world is 3 days: As for yesterday, it has vanished along with all that was in it. As for tomorrow, you may never see it. As for today, it is yours, so work on it.
quotes.author: al-Hasan al-Basri

quotes.quote: The poor man shuddered, overflowed with an angelic joy; he declared in his transport that this would last through life; he said to himself that he really had not suffered enough to deserve such radiant happiness, and he thanked God, in the depths of his soul, for having permitted that he, a miserable man, should be so loved by this innocent being.
quotes.author: Victor Hugo,  Les MisÃ©rables

quotes.quote: As we express our gratitude, we must never forget that the highest appreciation is not to utter words, but to live by them.
quotes.author: John F. Kennedy

quotes.quote: After every storm, there is a rainbow. If you have eyes, you will find it. If you have wisdom, you will create it. If you have love for yourself and others, you won't need it.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: The more I understand the mind and the human experience, the more I begin to suspect there is no such thing as unhappiness; there is only ungratefulness.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: I cry, but not for myself. There's too much sadness in this world to waste a moment with self-pity, when making others smile will also make me smile.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Write like no one is reading 3

quotes.quote: He who does not reflect his life back to God in gratitude does not know himself.
quotes.author: Albert Schweitzer,  Reverence for Life: The Words of Albert Schweitzer

quotes.quote: A grateful mindset can set you free from the prison of disempowerment and the shackles of misery.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Regardless of Sunshine or Rain, Be Thankful for another GREAT day...and treat Life as the ULTIMATE Gift.... Because IT IS :)
quotes.author: Pablo

quotes.quote: We only live once. We all have an expiration date after that we will never come again. I am not saying that to make you sad. I am saying that so you can cherish each moment in your life and be grateful that you are here and you are Special
quotes.author: Pablo

quotes.quote: When we replace a sense of service and gratitude with a sense of entitlement and expectation, we quickly see the demise of our relationships, society, and economy.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Your dream is a reality that is waiting for you to materialize. Today is a new day! Don't let your history interfere with your destiny! Learn from your past so that it can empower your present and propel you to greatness
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: If you want to find happiness, find gratitude.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: If I die with a zillion dollars and you die with zero, our net worth is worthless. All that matters is the love we level across our lives.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Everyone creates realities based on their own personal beliefs. These beliefs are so powerful that they can create [expansive or entrapping] realities over and over.~Kuan Yin
quotes.author: Hope Bradford,  Beneficial Law of Attraction: The Manifestation Teachings

quotes.quote: I may not be where I want to be but I'm thankful for not being where I used to be.
quotes.author: Habeeb Akande

quotes.quote: It has been said that life has treated me harshly; and sometimes I have complained in my heart because many pleasures of human experience have been withheld from me...if much has been denied me, much, very much, has been given me...
quotes.author: Helen Keller,  The Open Door

quotes.quote: I see the glass half full and thank God for what I have.
quotes.author: Ana Monnar

quotes.quote: In honor of Oprah Winfrey: Even greater than the ability to inspire others with hope is the power to motivate them to give as much to the lives of others as they would give to their own; and to empower them to confront the worst in themselves in order to discover and claim the best in themselves.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  Journey through the Power of the Rainbow: Quotations from a Life Made Out of Poetry

quotes.quote: Gratitude always comes into play; research shows that people are happier if they are grateful for the positive things in their lives, rather than worrying about what might be missing.
quotes.author: Dan Buettner,  Thrive: Finding Happiness the Blue Zones Way

quotes.quote: Divide the constant tide and random noisiness of energetic flow, with conscious recurring moments of empty mind, solitude, gratitude and deep...slow...breathing. Of this, the natural law of self-preservation demands.
quotes.author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

quotes.quote: Saying thanks to the world, and acknowledging your own accomplishments, is a great way to feel good and stay positive.
quotes.author: Rachel Robins,  How To Feel Good About Yourself - Boost Your Confidence & Tackle Low Self Esteem. Packed with Self Improvement Techniques, Positive Thinking Tips & Inspirational Quotes

quotes.quote: Your comfort zone is a place where you keep yourself in a self-illusion and nothing can grow there but your potentiality can grow only when you can think and grow out of that zone.
quotes.author: Rashedur Ryan Rahman

quotes.quote: You're all incredibly thoughtful souls who keep my head attached to my body.
quotes.author: Jenny Sampirisi,  Croak

quotes.quote: Great things happen to those who don't stop believing, trying, learning, and being grateful.
quotes.author: Roy T. Bennett,  The Light in the Heart

quotes.quote: I am thankful to all the souls, I meet in the journey of life.
quotes.author: Lailah Gifty Akita,  Think Great: Be Great!

quotes.quote: A sign of gratitude is a thankful smile.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Your success should create a path that inspires others to follow.
quotes.author: Amitav Chowdhury

quotes.quote: Be mindful. Be grateful. Be positive. Be true. Be kind.
quotes.author: Roy T. Bennett,  The Light in the Heart

quotes.quote: Start your day with appreciation and gratitude.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Your life looks like a prison because you focus on the things you wish you had and thus don't appreciate what you already have.So why don't you try to see the abundance in your life? Because, if you haven't noticed, you've got many things to thank for. Just look around.
quotes.author: Lidiya K.,  This Moment

quotes.quote: Simply just BE GRATEFUL what you have today, there is millions who'are crying for the place where you are today
quotes.author: Rashedur Rahman

quotes.quote: Gratitude is where every positive attitude starts.
quotes.author: Michael Hyatt,  Living Forward: A Proven Plan to Stop Drifting and Get the Life You Want

quotes.quote: It's easy and natural to be thankful when your expectations are met. The real test of your faith is when things don't go your way, or when you are in pain.
quotes.author: Maddy Malhotra,  How to Build Self-Esteem and Be Confident: Overcome Fears, Break Habits, Be Successful and Happy
